assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT code 93229
The denial is based on reason code PR-204
The requested service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The patient is enrolled with Federal Medicare (sim)
